instrument: Loudoun County published figures, as of March 1 2026
summary: Approximately 233 data center buildings totalling about 56.5 million square feet are built or in various stages of construction. The average existing building is roughly 234,000 square feet; permits issued since 2023 average closer to 339,000. The county issued building permits for more than 10 million square feet in 2025 alone.

source.citation: Energy News Beat, September 17 2026, reporting Loudoun County data

notes: The 233 figure counts buildings, not facilities or campuses. Reporting elsewhere describes the same number as data centers, which is a different unit and a live source of count error in this subject. County staff estimate the separately recorded 35.7 million approved-unbuilt square feet could represent about 115 more buildings. The growth in average permitted building size from roughly 234,000 to 339,000 square feet is a measurable trend not tracked elsewhere in this corpus.
confidence_note: No county document has been read; figures are carried from a single secondary account attributing them to county data. Whether the 233 count and the 56.5 million square feet are measured on the same basis is NOT_CHECKED.
